rules.tm_compatibility_policy: TM lists are generated compatibility, not TM-exclusive moves. Originu learns every valid TM. Other species use natural/tutor moves, explicit species, compatible types, then affinity/profile rules from techniqueMachines.json and codex identity.
rules.generation_note: Generated by scripts/generate-learnsets.mjs. Hand-tune individual learnsets by updating generator rules so learnsets.json and species.json stay aligned.
